name: AI SEO Masterclass
body:
> Course · 2026-10-08

# Summary
"The Monster AI SEO / LLM SEO" course by Jacky Chou (Indexsy, LocalRank.so) on the Local Rank Academy Skool community, saved as 14 PDFs on 2026-10-08. It covers traditional SEO foundations, GEO/AI citation strategy, local SEO in the AI era, parasite and Reddit tactics, AI content workflow, tools, case studies and copy-paste SOPs.

# Big ideas worth keeping
- AI engines cite structured, fresh, question-answering content: "Best X" lists, comparisons, how-to guides, original data.
- Freshness is the strongest AI citation signal in the course's data (79.1% of cited content updated in the current year).
- FAQPage and HowTo schema, answer-first paragraphs and question headings make content easy to extract.
- Brand mentions (even unlinked) build AI visibility; reviews and NAP consistency still drive local.
- Measure AI visibility on purpose: query testing, AI referrals in GA4, citation tracking.

# TAG caution
Several modules teach tactics that break Google, Reddit or FTC rules (PBNs, account farming, vote manipulation, fake customer testimonials, Q&A seeding, paid "direction" traffic). Use the structure, freshness, schema and measurement lessons; leave the manipulation tactics out of client work. Revenue numbers are the author's unverified claims.
